However, the failure to render legible text in speech bubbles and the price box undermines the 'functional component' of serialized storytelling, preventing a perfect alignment score.

Structural anomalies in the character's anatomy, specifically the fused/uncertain hands and hips (confirmed by high-risk pose audit), further degrade quality.
